changes: Fixes installed upgrades failing with DeleteFile failed; code 5 (Access is denied) while replacing NewzDeckTray.exe after the tray window had already disappeared.

Changes Setup tray shutdown from window-only polling to process-authoritative shutdown: Setup captures the tray process ID/handle before WM_CLOSE and waits for that process to signal exit before overlaying files.

Adds a bounded forced-termination fallback for an unresponsive process owning the NewzDeck tray window, followed by a second bounded process-exit wait; Setup aborts before overlay if shutdown still cannot be confirmed.

Strengthens the Windows installer smoke test so NewzDeckTray.exe deliberately remains alive and file-locked for six seconds after its hidden window is destroyed, reproducing the race that escaped v3.6.1.
Preserves the v3.6.1 confirmed background-service stop gate, the accepted v3.6.0 UI/UX Overhaul, and all established runtime/download/Automation/Smart Import/Discover behavior.
